thread:
chao: quick heads-up — nightly perf spike on fused-attn with QKV packing + bias+rope fusion (long seq). ~18% regression vs last good build. attaching quick profile snapshot.

chao: perf summary:
```
model=redwood-13b-fuse variant=fused_qkv_biasrope batch=1 seq=4096 throughput=230 tok/s baseline=280 tok/s (-17.9%)
kernel=chosen:fused_qkv_biasrope_lanegate v=1.2.3
notes: large L2 miss-rate, epilogue memcpy doubled, sustained SM occupancy ok
```

maria: saw similar on my run earlier but assumed noise. do we have kernel-selector logs? could be falling back to compact flash variant with prefetch off.

chao: pasted selector snippet:
```
[kernel_selector] input:{seq=4096, batch=1, qk_chunk=128, kv_mode=flat}
[kernel_selector] candidates=[fused_qkv_biasrope_lanegate, flash_compact, paged_fused]
[kernel_selector] heuristics: prefer=fused if seq>1024 and mem_ratio>0.6
[kernel_selector] chosen=fused_qkv_biasrope_lanegate prefetch=auto lane_gating=on async_memcpy=false
```

alex: hmm lane_gating=on + async_memcpy=false could explain extra copies in epilogue. quick experiment: try lane_gating=off + prefetch=on (force) and compare.

chao: re-ran with overrides (lane_gating=off prefetch=on): throughput -> 265 tok/s (still ~5% below baseline but much better). profile shows epilogue memcpy reduced by ~60%.

layla: is KV paging involved? paged-KV previously caused scatter copies when seq >> window.

chao: this run used kv_mode=flat, so paging not in play. epilogue path itself doing extra copy with lane_gating enabled.

dmitri: possible root cause: lane_gating path inserts per-lane pack/unpack to support variable lane lengths which forces a memmove to align. With large seq the L2 working set increases and thrashes.

maria: proposed quick mitigation: selector rule override: if seq>=3072 and batch<=1 then prefer fused variant with async_memcpy=true and lane_gating=off. add telemetry event when chosen.

alex: agree, add microbenchmark (seq=2048/3072/4096) sweep in CI and add a perf-check threshold.

chao: added a short reproducer and numbers to the thread: reproduced on g5x2 hosts, kernel binary v1.2.3.

perf-bot: canary job created: canary/fused-lanegate-fix on 10 hosts (start 2267804500).

infra-bot: rolling canary to infra-pool-3 now. monitor logs: /var/log/redwood/inference/canary-fuse.log

maria: followups: 1) short-term selector heuristic change + telemetry 2) add lane-gating epilogue async memcpy opt (medium) 3) longer-term: evaluate packed-epilogue variant that avoids per-lane unpack for long seq (design doc).

chao: I can open the selector PR now and attach the reproducer. will also dump the nvprof timeline to the ticket.

layla: add note to KV-cache doc that lane_gating interacts poorly with long-seq L2 footprint — this will help oncalls.

dmitri: +1. If canary shows improvement we promote to stable after 24h.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks team.

./run_infer --model redwood-13b-fuse --variant fused_qkv_biasrope --batch 1 --seq 4096 --override lane_gating=off prefetch=on
# profile
